To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the relationship between profitability and reinsurer utilisation is positive, while the relationship between profitability, reinsurance dependence and exposure is insignificant.

the reinsurance utilisation has a positive effect on the profitability of non-life insurance firms, while the dependence and exposure of non-life insurance firm on reinsurance do not affect the profitability of nonlife insurance firms.

reinsurance utilisation has a significant impact on the performance (measured in terms of return on assets) of the domestic private sector non-life insurance companies operating in Pakistan, while the dependence and exposure of reinsurers has no significant impact on the profitability of the insurance companies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of reinsurance utilised on profitability of private sector non- life stock insurers in Pakistan.
the impact of reinsurance utilisations and dependence on the profitability of the firm.
the impact of reinsurance utilising on the performance of non-life stock insurance firms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
profitability is positively affected by reinsurance utilisation.
reinsurance utilisation has a positive impact on the profitability of private sector non life stock insurance companies operating under the supervision of the SECP in Pakistan.
reinsurance utilisation has a positive impact on the performance and profitability of the firm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
reinsurance utilisation has a positive effect on profitability and reinsurance dependence has a neutral impact on profitability of the firm.
reinsurance utilisation is a positive and significant determinant of the profitability of non-life insurance firms.
reinsurance is not only important for the expansion of the industry but also has a positive impact on the profitability of the firm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
reinsurance utilisation is an important factor in improving the profitability of the firm.
the reinsurance utilisation is a significant factor in determining the profitability of the insurance companies in the private sector.
reinsurance can play a vital role in the performance of insurance companies, especially when they are operating in a highly competitive market like Pakistan.
